launches.title: Pango: E-commerce operations on autopilot.
launches.tagline: Why can't e-commerce companies scale like tech companies?
launches.body:
tl;dr: Why can't e-commerce companies scale like tech companies? And how we might be able to change that.

We spent 12 months embedded in the operations of 30 e-commerce brands\! Here’s what we learnt:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107204&key=user_uploads/3288698/1a3cc8c3-db71-4d81-b2ad-9679b77f9451)

**What we saw:** Each company had a unique operational setup with a mix of 5 to 7 tools glued together to run the shop. To keep all these tools running smoothly with each other, it requires a lot of tedious admin. As a result, headcount increases as the company scales.

Most companies couldn't even automate a basic return processing, let alone offer exchanging items or build an AI agent to approve returns or send shipping label to the customer.

Expansion made it worse: more countries and/or SKUs = exponentially more problems.

**What we built:** We have built an agentic OS for e-commerce: You connect your shop stack, then describe how you want to handle shipments, returns, refunds, or claims → Pango builds the return portal, fixes the delivery options, and builds a customer service process and agent for you.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107204&key=user_uploads/3288698/ceed8a01-52aa-403a-9986-758da64ff4e4)

**Result:** So far we have managed to automate 99% of returns and shipping operations, reduce operation costs by 20% and sign 30 global brands.
